deprecations.name: accessibleLabel

replacement.name: aria-label
replacement.usage: Use element.ariaLabel or setAttribute('aria-label', label); host attribute presence takes precedence over the compatibility fallback.

deprecations.rationale: The native host accessible-name API replaces this fallback property. The earlier accessible-label attribute deprecation has its own published release window; the programmatic property remains supported throughout its later window.

deprecations.name: lr-lightbox-close

replacement.name: lr-close
replacement.usage: Observe lr-close with detail.reason after dismissal; use lr-close-request to veto it. The legacy event retains its string detail and pre-close cancellation.

deprecations.rationale: The shared close notification reports a reason object; a separate close-request event owns cancellation. The former lightbox-specific event remains compatible throughout the deprecation window.

deprecations.name: lr-before-media-download
deprecations.rationale: Renamed to the library's dominant *-request veto-event convention. Both names fire from the same activation of a safe file anchor with an equal { src, filename } detail during the compatibility window, the canonical name first, and either may veto the native download/open. A veto through the alias logs a one-time development warning.
